card.name: Striving for a better life for family
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about working or sacrificing for a better life, future or provision for one's family or children, such as "better life for" or "we owe them". It sits on the word just before the beneficiary ("themselves", "our children", "ourselves").

modes.label: Better life for others
modes.description: Words in phrases like "a better life for" or "better future for" that lead into family or children.
modes.example: the Chinese Settlers came to the United States for a better life<< for>> themselves and their family.

modes.label: Owing or providing
modes.description: Verbs of obligation or provision such as owe or provide, just before the person they are owed to.

card.plain: It marks speech about struggling or owing something so that family or future generations can have a better life.
